verdict: Keep Mirror Image eligible for a defensive shelf only for Arcane with publicly verified current Refractive Images selection. Do not remove it wholesale based on the older baseline damage-reduction removal.
plain_english: With Refractive Images selected, Arcane Mage delays some incoming damage; casting Mirror Image temporarily increases the portion delayed. The damage is still dealt later, so this is damage smoothing, not 30% damage reduction, healing, an absorb, or immunity.
